conventions.seedDerivation: SHA-256(UTF-8('2048-infinite/v1:' + seed)); first 16 bytes -> 4 little-endian uint32 words; all-zero -> [1,0,0,0]
conventions.uniform: limit = 2^32 - (2^32 mod n); draw until x < limit; return x mod n; each raw draw (incl. rejected, and the single draw for n=1) advances the PRNG
conventions.spawn: empties row-major; pos = empties[uniform(len)]; v = uniform(10); exponent '2' if v < fourWeight else '1'; default fourWeight = 1
conventions.newGame: two spawns on empty board; rulesetVersion classic-v1 for 4x4 else practice-v1
conventions.checksum: lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (fixed key order, no whitespace)

rejectionCase.description: uniform(n) where the first raw draw(s) are >= limit and are rejected; every rejected draw still advances the PRNG

highValue.description: hand-built 4x4 state; tiles 53,53 (row 0) and 4095,4095 (row 1) slide left; rng words = derive('high-value')
